profile_text.body:
Zoom is a publicly traded communications company (NASDAQ: ZM, CIK 0001585521) that describes itself as offering a single platform of collaboration tools covering video meetings, Zoom Chat, VoIP phone, webinars, whiteboard, contact center, and events.

The company's site emphasizes AI as a built-in layer across its platform. It describes meeting summarization and automated next steps as standard AI features, with a product called ZoomMate positioned to go further by generating assets such as decks and documents. The tracked AI product is Zoom AI Companion, categorized under Chat and General LLMs, with meeting summarization and recording consent noted as relevant capabilities.

No litigation or MCP server entries are held for Zoom at this time.
